test_copilot_env_var_token_priority: test that env var token wins over credential pool in copilot API key resolution
test_copilot_oauth_pool_fallback: test that copilot API key resolution falls back to OAuth token from credential pool
test_copilot_pool_exception_handling: test that copilot API key resolution falls back to pool when env resolution raises an exception
test_copilot_classic_pat_skip: test that classic PAT tokens starting with ghp are skipped in the credential pool
test_copilot_invalid_pool_entries: test that invalid pool entries are skipped until the first exchangeable OAuth token is found
